pages.text: The $(l)Dummy$() is the ultimate stationary distraction. It cannot move or attack, but its sturdy build lets it soak up massive damage.

pages.title: Unit Statistics
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 20$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 20$(li)$(4)Resistance:$() Knockback$(br2)High armor allows it to survive while your other units eliminate threats.

pages.title: The Taunt Mechanic
pages.text: Every $(b)10s$(), the Dummy $(6)taunts$() hostile mobs within $(b)20 blocks$(), acting as a $(b)Mob Magnet$() to keep you safe.
